article.title: ZEPIC公布Neura，把廣告入口接到購物對話
article.summary: ZEPIC稱Neura可讓部分廣告及商家檔案把顧客帶到WhatsApp，也支援品牌網站聊天。
highlights: 公告列出Shopify、Magento和客戶資料平台等接入例子。
公司描述了附近門店庫存查詢及轉交真人客服。
article.why: 零售團隊可在同一條顧客旅程評估廣告入口、商品查詢和客服交接。
article.next_step: 先選一個廣告入口，確認可接入的商品資料、庫存更新頻率及客服轉接條件。
article.detail: ZEPIC公布對話式購物工具Neura，入口包括可導向WhatsApp的廣告或商家檔案，以及品牌網站聊天。公司展示接入電商與客戶資料系統後的使用情境，包括查詢附近門店存貨及轉交真人客服。品牌規劃試點時應先確認各入口、商店系統及客服隊列的接入條件。
article.title_en: ZEPIC introduces Neura to connect ad entry points with shopping chats
article.summary_en: ZEPIC says selected ads and business profiles can send customers to WhatsApp, and Neura also supports chat on brand sites.
highlights_en: The announcement names Shopify, Magento and customer data systems as integration examples.
ZEPIC describes nearby store stock checks and handoff to human support.
article.why_en: Retail teams can assess ad entry, product questions and service handoffs as one customer journey.
article.next_step_en: Choose one ad entry point and confirm product data, inventory refresh rates and support handoff rules.
article.detail_en: ZEPIC announced Neura, a conversational shopping product with entry points including ads or profiles that lead to WhatsApp and chat on a brand website. Its announced commerce and customer data integrations support scenarios such as checking nearby store stock and handing off to a person. Confirm each channel, store system and support queue before a pilot.
